A '''battle''' in the [[Cha Raaba system]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] took place in [[3639 BBY]] during the [[Galactic War]]. [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warlord [[Varek Tarn]] stole the construction plans for the [[Sovereign Forge]], a secret Imperial mining station and shipyard, and attempted to sell them to the Republic at a minefield in the Cha Raaba system.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==The battle==
The [[Empire's Fury]] squadron was sent to intercept Varek Tarn and was almost immediately ambushed by a pair of [[Plug-6 heavy fighter]]s, defeating them whilst approaching the minefield. Bypassing a [[Unidentified freighter class|Mandalorian frigate]] and damaging a [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]], the Empire's Fury began to pursue the [[Republic transport shuttle|Republic shuttle]] being escorted by Varek Tarn himself, piloting an [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]], and two further Plug-6 fighters. During the intense dogfight among the systems asteriods, the shuttle carrying the plans, Varek Tarn and his fighters were destroyed. The Republic corvette subsequently moved to escape the asteroid field and jump to hyperspace but was also destroyed by the Empire's Fury before it could do so.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cha Raaba Assault is an Imperial-side space mission in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
